title: Black Bean Burgers
description: Hearty black bean burgers with a crisp crust and smoky spices that hold together on the pan, served on buns with your toppings.

image.alt: A black bean burger with lettuce, tomato and avocado

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 325F oven}. Spread the beans on the baking sheet and bake until they look dry and some split open, {time 15 min}. Drying them is what stops the burgers turning mushy.
Meanwhile heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet and cook the onion until soft, {time 5 min}. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chili powder for {time 1 min}.
Mash the warm beans in a bowl, leaving some chunky. Mix in the onion mixture, egg, panko, cheese and salt until it holds together.
Shape into {count 6} patties about {len 3/4 in} thick. Chill for {time 15 min} if they feel soft.
Heat the rest of the oil in the skillet over medium heat and cook the patties until crisp and heated through, {time 4-5 min} per side. Serve on toasted buns with avocado and your favorite toppings.

notes: Freeze shaped patties between parchment for up to 3 months; cook from frozen, a few minutes longer per side.
